primary_title: Human Astrocytes: Secretome Profiles of Cytokines and Chemokines
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1beta plus TNF as a validated astrocyte inflammatory stimulus; the cited primary protein-secretome study detects new CCL3/MIP-1alpha production after combined stimulation of highly purified human astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: Combined-input secreted-protein output only; preserve human astrocyte and protein-array context, distinguish CCL3 release from any transcript inference and later CCR1/CCR5 binding, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.
